title: Rooftop Rover
body: The Rooftop Rover is a fully custom Mercedes Sprinter camper van conversion built for comfort, functionality and off-road adventure. Designed by Papago Vans, this luxury van build is equipped with everything you need for extended off-grid living, weekend escapes or full-time vanlife.

Inside, you'll find a queen-size memory foam bed with flares wrapped in matte black for extra sleeping space, plus a pop-top roof with a second bed and LED lighting, perfect for families or guests. A removable ladder provides easy access to the rooftop bunk, making this van a two-level getaway on wheels.

The kitchen features an acacia butcher block countertop, in-counter double burner induction cooktop, stainless steel undermount sink with hot and cold water, and a tiled mirrored hexagon backsplash for a touch of modern flair. There's also a built-in microwave, 3 cubic foot refrigerator with freezer, pull-out spice rack, and plenty of upper and lower cabinet storage.

Stay comfortable year-round with a 12V Dometic rooftop air conditioner, Espar diesel cabin heater, deluxe insulation package, and Maxxair Deluxe fan with remote. A 4-gallon electric water heater, indoor collapsible shower and rear outdoor shower ensure you’re covered no matter where you roam.

For power, this build includes a 400W solar system with Renogy MPPT charger, dual REGO 400Ah lithium battery packs, a 2500W pure sine inverter/charger, and shore power hookup. There's also a 60Amp DC-DC charger to keep things charged on the go. Multiple 110V outlets with USB-A and USB-C ports keep devices powered throughout the van.

This camper van is built for rugged travel, too—complete with an Owl Pismo front bumper, Warn 12s winch, Baja Designs LP4 Pro amber lights, Owl B2 bike carrier, Monster Box, ladder with spare tire carrier, and FVCO heavy-duty pull-out bike trays. The ARB onboard air compressor and exterior perimeter lighting make off-road life that much easier.
With its clean design, thoughtful storage solutions, and off-grid readiness, Rooftop Rover is the ultimate camper van for anyone ready to explore without limits.
